business_problem: The bank wants to reduce the manual effort involved in reviewing customer onboarding documents and identifying incomplete KYC cases.
success_criteria: Reduce manual first-level KYC review effort
Identify missing or inconsistent customer information
Provide explainable recommendations for human reviewers

business_problem: The insurer wants to improve the triage of incoming claims by automatically classifying cases, identifying severity indicators, and routing complex claims to specialist teams.
success_criteria: Keep final claims decisions with human staff

business_problem: The lender wants to accelerate underwriting preparation by extracting borrower information from financial documents and producing a structured summary for human underwriters.
success_criteria: Reduce time spent preparing underwriting cases
Keep the final lending decision with a human underwriter
